about:
# Per Hour - WoW Forever

Measure XP, estimated net Gold, honor and reputation in one shared activity session.
Targets **WoW Forever (Interface 16001)**. Native rendering and event ordering
still require in-game validation.

## Install

Extract into `_forever_\Interface\AddOns\per-hour`, with `per-hour.toc` directly
inside that folder, then restart WoW and enable the addon.
For a linked development checkout on Windows, run `.\scripts\install.ps1` once.

**Updating to the revamp:** previous tracker sessions and preferences are not
imported. The revamp starts with its own defaults and empty history.

## Use

- Left-click the minimap clock to show/hide Per Hour; right-click opens Settings.
- Start / Pause / Resume controls every metric together. Hidden panels keep capturing.
- Finish Session in Sessions or the current Session window lets you edit the title, confirms saving to History and waits for another Start.
- Sessions > Current Session opens metrics, reputation by faction and grouped Gold Income/Expenses.
- History opens saved sessions, supports Rename and confirmed Delete, and compares two
  selected sessions with all metrics. Its character selector can show other characters.
- Settings controls Focused / Extended / Full, metric order, /h or /m, duration,
  separate XP/reputation estimates, XP speedometer and watched faction. Use metric selectors or arrows to reorder.
- Changing faction preserves earlier results. None stops only reputation capture.
- Reload restores the verified state; normal logout returns to a paused session.
- /perhour opens Settings; /perhour xp|gold|honor|rep shows the shared panel.
- Session > Announce shares a live metric only after selecting a chat channel.

History keeps 100 summaries per character and details of the latest 20 sessions,
up to 1,000 consultable events each. Finish freezes unresolved Gold as incomplete.
See [usage and in-game test checklist](https://github.com/eavidaze/wow-addon-per-hour/blob/main/docs/panels.md),
[Gold accounting](https://github.com/eavidaze/wow-addon-per-hour/blob/main/docs/gold-tracking.md) and [session continuity](https://github.com/eavidaze/wow-addon-per-hour/blob/main/docs/session-continuity.md).

## Development

Run from the repository root:

    lua tests/forever.lua          # Lua 5.1
    .\scripts\package.ps1          # Local ZIP in dist\

If Lua is unavailable, install the optional development runtime with
python -m pip install --target dist/runtime lupa, then run
python scripts/lua51.py tests/forever.lua. This executes actual Lua 5.1;
the runtime is excluded from the addon package.
See [architecture](https://github.com/eavidaze/wow-addon-per-hour/blob/main/docs/stores.md) and [releasing](https://github.com/eavidaze/wow-addon-per-hour/blob/main/docs/releasing.md).

Original author: José Júnior. Thanks to Zwietabak and AssisrMatheus. [MIT license](https://github.com/eavidaze/wow-addon-per-hour/blob/main/LICENSE).

# 2.0.1-forever

Keep the Session window steady when switching tabs and simplify its title.

Changes are compared with [v2.0.0](https://github.com/eavidaze/wow-addon-per-hour/releases/tag/v2.0.0),
the previous published Forever release. The release title and tag are `v2.0.1`.

## Fixed

- Keep the window's width, height and scale unchanged when switching between
  Income, Expenses and Reputation. All tabs reserve the space needed by the
  largest table header, avoiding the resize and screen-fit flicker caused by
  their different header heights. Tab contents remain scrollable, and wrapped
  session metadata can still expand the window when necessary.

## Changed

- Rename the Session Details window to Session, for both current and archived
  sessions. Sessions > Current Session continues to open the same window.

## Compatibility and limitations

- Targets WoW Forever 1.60.1, Interface `16001`, with Lua 5.1.
- No data migration, settings migration or new reset is introduced. Sessions,
  history and preferences created in 2.0.0 keep their existing formats.

## Validation

- Automated: 1,433 simulation checks passed with actual Lua 5.1 through Python's
  `lupa.lua51` runner, including repeated tab switching without a window resize,
  unchanged width/height/scale, the new title, and existing capture/history checks.
- Local package: `per-hour-2.0.1-forever.zip` verified for its `per-hour/` root,
  matching TOC version and Interface, source contents, 49 exact-case nested
  TOC/XML load references, embedded libraries/licenses and excluded development
  files. All 60 packaged source files match the candidate.
- Native rendering and the absence of visible flicker still require in-game
  confirmation, including different UI scales, long session metadata, current
  and archived sessions, and scrolling all three tabs. Simulation checks are
  separate from in-game validation.

# 2.0.0-forever

Per Hour's session revamp replaces separate trackers with one configurable
dashboard, a shared measurement period and saved results you can review and compare.

Changes are compared with [v1.6.1](https://github.com/eavidaze/wow-addon-per-hour/releases/tag/v1.6.1),
the previous published Forever release. The release title and tag are `v2.0.0`.

## Added

- Start, Pause, Resume and Finish one session for XP, Gold, honor and reputation
  together. Hiding the dashboard keeps capture running; Finish archives the result
  and waits for the next Start.
- Save named results in History, filter by character or all characters, open
  archived Details, rename sessions and delete them after confirmation. New titles
  suggest the starting area, local date and time; Finish lets you edit that title.
- Compare two saved sessions side by side across hourly XP, Gold, honor and every
  faction present in either session. The greater rate is gold, with a green
  triangle and percentage advantage when a valid opposing baseline exists.
- Keep each reputation faction's gains and tracked time when changing the watched
  faction during a session. Selecting None stops only reputation capture.
- Choose Focused, Extended or Full dashboard layouts, reorder metrics and enable
  XP and reputation milestone estimates independently, including both together.

## Changed

- Rebuild Session Details around a fixed summary card and separate Income,
  Expenses and Reputation tabs. Gold rows group retained items or money sources,
  show quantities and recorded valuations, and keep each flow's sum and table
  headings fixed while its rows scroll.
- Use a compact Compare panel with larger readings, gold session headings and a
  centered `vs.`. Rates show explicit spaced units: `xp/h`, `g/h`, `hon/h` and
  `rep/h`. The table compares rates; session duration remains contextual metadata.
  Value tooltips contain the inverse minute rate and total. Ties and zero/missing
  opposing baselines have no percentage; unavailable readings display zero with
  their metric unit.
- Keep History sessions on single rows with inline Rename, Details and Delete
  actions. Standard windows share native stacking, initial cascade placement and
  screen fitting. Session popups use centered larger text and shared title input.
- Offer History, Current Session and a separate Finish Session button in Sessions.
  The menu and current Details footer share the same confirmation and title editor;
  Cancel, X and Escape discard the draft without finishing or renaming the session.
  Confirmation is bound to the current session ID, so a stale dialog cannot finish
  a replacement session.
- Display numeric Gold rates and native coin totals. Dashboard metric tooltips show
  the total and the opposite rate period; full recorded accounting stays available
  in Details. Dashboard estimates use the same shared session and respect pauses.
- On normal logout/login, restore the current session paused without archiving it.
  A verified reload restores its previous state; offline, loading and verification
  time are excluded. Uncertain continuity stays paused with partial coverage.
- Freeze Gold at Finish with the prices and evidence available at confirmation.
  Unresolved values are excluded and marked incomplete; later responses cannot
  change the archived result or carry those movements into another session.

## Fixed

- Make both XP and reputation estimate texts follow session status: gray before
  Start/after Finish, green while running and yellow while paused or verifying
  restored continuity, matching Duration and the action indicator.
- Combine the first name and surname returned by Forever when labeling characters,
  and omit the realm separator when the client returns an empty realm.

## Compatibility and limitations

- Targets WoW Forever 1.60.1, Interface `16001`, with Lua 5.1. Optional TSM and
  Auctionator pricing and the standard minimap/broker launcher remain supported.
- This is a fresh session/settings model: pre-revamp tracker sessions and
  preferences are not imported. No saved-data or settings migration is introduced.
- History retains 100 summaries per character, details for the latest 20 and up to
  1,000 consultable Gold events per session. Tab sums cover retained known events,
  so they may differ from the complete session totals. These display limits do
  not truncate active accounting.
- Item pricing remains estimated farming value. Mail, transfers, purchases and
  vendor-sale receipts stay outside the recorded income/expense boundaries.

## Validation

- Automated: 1,416 simulation checks passed with actual Lua 5.1 through Python's
  `lupa.lua51` runner, covering the shared lifecycle and recovery, Gold accounting,
  grouped Details, saved history, comparison calculations, title validation,
  independent estimates, native menu contracts and virtualized scrolling.
- Local package: `per-hour-2.0.0-forever.zip` checked for its `per-hour/` root,
  TOC version and Interface, exact-case nested TOC/XML load references, source
  contents, embedded libraries and licenses, and excluded development files.
  All 60 packaged files match the source; 49 load references resolve with exact
  casing. All packaged Lua sources compile with Lua 5.1 and XML sources parse.
- Screenshots from in-game iteration informed the interface changes, but a full
  final-candidate gameplay check has not been established. Confirm the final
  Sessions button and dialogs, long session/faction labels, Compare alignment,
  percentages and scrolling, all Gold/Reputation tabs, layouts and estimates,
  minimap access, reload/logout continuity and optional pricing addons in game.
  Simulation results do not establish native rendering or gameplay compatibility.

# 1.6.0-forever

Track estimated net gold alongside XP, Honor and Reputation, and inspect the
income and expenses recorded during your farming session.

Changes are compared with [v1.5.0](https://github.com/eavidaze/wow-addon-per-hour/releases/tag/v1.5.0),
the previous published Forever release. The release title and tag are `v1.6.0`.

## Added

- Enable **Gold** from the minimap menu or Settings to track estimated net gold
  per hour or minute. Include looted money, quest money and received item values;
  subtract consumables used, valuable items delivered to completed quests,
  personal repairs and paid flights. Pause, Resume, Reset, hidden tracking,
  per-character session persistence and Announce work with Gold as well.
- Left-click the Gold tracker or choose **Gold → Options → Details** to open its
  scrolling event journal. Review income, expenses and estimated net profit;
  inspect event times, item quantities and native item/quest tooltips.
- Value eligible items with optional **TSM → Auctionator → vendor** pricing,
  using TSM's DBMarket or Auctionator's last scan with vendor as the minimum.
  Neither integration is required. The item tooltip in Details identifies the
  recorded price source and value, including portions valued at different prices.
- Freeze item prices when recorded. Consumables and quest deliveries use the
  oldest available recorded acquisition values first; unmatched stock receives
  a quote when used. Selling or transferring items removes their units from
  that allocation without adding income or a speculative expense.

## Changed

- Format Gold totals and announcements in gold, silver and copper, with decimal
  gold rates in the tracker. Details uses local event clock times, quantity
  suffixes, entry/exit arrows and distinct outgoing values.
- Keep valid per-character rate preferences. Characters without a valid saved
  hourly/per-minute preference now default to hourly instead of importing older
  account-level module preferences. If only the old account preference existed,
  select per-minute again in Settings; new modules no longer affect that choice.

## Fixed

- Recover pending item prices from the native cache after session verification,
  world entry and pause/resume, including replies received while restoration was
  pending. Accepted entries can settle while paused without counting new gains.
- Preserve already confirmed quest deliveries across pause/resume and loading
  screens within their original confirmation window, avoiding lost or duplicate
  item expenses when bag updates arrive later.
- Prevent sold, mailed, traded, banked or otherwise removed units from supplying
  stale acquisition prices to later replacements. Stock availability survives
  reload, including observed losses whose runtime confirmation was interrupted.

## Compatibility and limitations

- Targets WoW Forever 1.60.1, Interface `16001`.
- Gold describes estimated farming value, not cash profit or guaranteed Auction
  House proceeds. Item values count on receipt; selling them adds nothing again.
  Mail, trade, bank transfers, purchases, buybacks, crafting and guild-funded
  repairs remain outside income/expense accounting. Market prices are gross,
  without Auction House commission or deposits.
- Native item data may remain pending until loaded. Known zero-value items are
  omitted. Existing saved prices retain their policy; no previous transactions
  or settings are migrated or backfilled.
- Consumption and quest deliveries require matching native actions and readable
  bag-count decreases. Short confirmation windows, ambiguous events, gains that
  mask losses and unobserved offline movements can leave actions unrecognized.
  Unrecorded runtime action correlations do not survive reload.
- Item/quest tooltips, external addon APIs, event order and protected/secret
  values still require actual Forever validation. See [Gold tracking](https://github.com/eavidaze/wow-addon-per-hour/blob/v1.6.0/docs/gold-tracking.md)
  for detailed accounting and detection boundaries.

## Validation

- Automated: 2,882 simulation checks passed with Lua 5.1 through Python's
  `lupa.lua51` runner, covering Gold accounting, provider fallbacks, recorded
  prices, mixed acquisition lots, pending data, quest delivery, stock retirement,
  pause/resume, reload and Details tooltips, alongside existing tracker checks.
- Local package: `per-hour-1.6.0-forever.zip` checked for its `per-hour/` root,
  matching TOC version and Interface, exact-case TOC/XML load references,
  source-file contents and excluded development files.
- In-game validation remains pending. Verify real looting, quest turn-ins,
  consumables, personal/guild repairs, flights, transfer exclusions, replacement
  stock, TSM/Auctionator APIs, Details rendering and session continuity in
  WoW Forever. Simulation results do not establish gameplay compatibility.
